name: Parry Trainer
tagline: Invisible attackers, real heavy melees. Learn to parry by sound and timing.
summary: A solo parry drill in a black arena. Hidden attackers wind up real heavy melees from a range you choose; add creep waves, timers and soul goals.
description: Parry Trainer by mapleroyal puts you in a quiet black arena with a random hero and invisible attackers that throw real Deadlock heavy melees. Set the distance they start from, how long they wait between swings, and a second attacker with its own rhythm. Add lane troopers and neutral camps to farm between parries, play to a timer or to parry and soul goals, and choose what a miss costs. Templates go from Easiest to Hardest, and your drills and hero builds can be saved. A scorecard at the end shows your parry rate, hits taken and souls.

howToPlay.title: Open the menu
howToPlay.body: Press the scoreboard key (Tab) to set up a session: a timer, goals or unlimited. Pick a template or tune the attackers yourself.

howToPlay.title: Parry the swing
howToPlay.body: Listen for the windup and parry as the heavy melee lands. A catch stuns the attacker. Keep moving: standing still drains your health.

howToPlay.title: Beat your score
howToPlay.body: Survive the timer or reach your goals to win. The scorecard shows parries, hits taken, accuracy and souls.

whatsNew: First Hideout release of mapleroyal's Parry Trainer 0.4.4.
